jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Our Company Background & Culture

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.

UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.

Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.

As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Director, Data & Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.

This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.

This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (two days per week in-office).

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Specific Accountabilities

The Senior Director, Data & Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:

Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
Guide the use of cloud-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self-asses the capabilities for progress
Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non-technical audiences.
Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector

Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
Understanding of relational and non-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
Experience designing and evolving cloud-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.

ATTRIBUTES

Excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to design and improve repeatable data practices
Ability to drive outcomes through collaboration across teams and contributors
Ability to engage and align business users, data owners and technology partners.
Ability to effectively identify emerging technologies, trends, standards, and products that have a strong potential to better enable UPP business units
Ability to enable consistent, governed data use at scale.

LIFE AT UPP

Do work that matters.
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

Stronger together.
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.

Grow every day.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on unique, once-in-a-career projects that maximize your skill set and probably teach you some new ones—at any stage in your career.

Benefits

Prioritize wellness.
At UPP, wellness takes many forms. Ultimately, it’s about ensuring our people are cared for in the ways that matter to them. Check out some highlights of our inclusive employee-focused benefits program including:

Defined benefit pension plan
Flexible hybrid work model
Paid time off – vacations, personal days and wellness days
Work remotely up to eight weeks/year
Comprehensive group benefits including medical, dental, vision, etc.
Extended paramedical and mental health service coverage
Health care and lifestyle spending accounts
Fertility treatments, paid parental leave, and gender affirmation coverage
Education Assistance program

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior GenAI Specialist to join our team in Mississauga, Canada. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge Generative AI (GenAI) solutions, including exploring and applying advanced concepts like Agentic AI, within our financial operations. This role offers a challenging opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, leveraging deep technical expertise in GenAI, LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, chatbot development, and related technologies. You will collaborate with engineers and stakeholders and drive innovation by applying GenAI to solve complex financial problems.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and implement GenAI solutions for various financial applications, including personalized recommendations, risk assessment, fraud detection, and automated reporting. Explore and experiment with advanced GenAI concepts like Agentic AI.
Design and implement intelligent AI Agents.
Process and analyze large datasets of structured and unstructured financial data.
Architect and implement efficient RAG pipelines, leveraging tools like LlamaIndex and LangChain.
Develop and refine advanced prompting strategies for LLMs.
Test, evaluate, and analyze the performance of LLM and other GenAI models.
Collaborate closely with engineering teams to deploy and maintain GenAI models in production environments, including containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure management.
Communicate effectively with business stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in GenAI research and development, including areas like Agentic AI.

Required Skills And Qualifications

5 years+ of experience in AI/ML development, with a proven track record of building and deploying sophisticated GenAI applications.
Deep understanding of GenAI models and architectures, including transformers, LLMs (e.g., Llama, Gemini, GPT-4), GANs, and diffusion models. Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts.
Extensive experience with prompt engineering, fine-tuning LLMs, and evaluating their performance.
Expert-level Python programming skills and proficiency with relevant libraries (e.g., Transformers, LangChain, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Flask/Django, LlamaIndex).
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Faiss, PostgreSQL with vector extensions) and implementing RAG pipelines using tools like LlamaIndex and LangChain.
Strong software engineering skills, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure management (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience with MLOps principles and tools.
Excellent collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with financial data and applications, particularly in areas like fraud detection, risk management, or personalized financial advice.
Strong understanding of financial markets and instruments.
Familiarity with chatbot development frameworks and best practices, including conversational AI design and natural language understanding (NLU).
Experience leading or contributing to complex data science or AI/ML projects in a fast-paced environment.
Publications or presentations at conferences related to AI/ML or GenAI.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn).
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or Relevant experience, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.

Technology Stack

Programming Languages: Python (expert proficiency required), SQL
Python Packages: Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Flask/Django, and other relevant data science, machine learning, and web development libraries.
Deep Learning Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch
LLMs: Llama, Gemini, GPT-4, and other advanced LLMs.
Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Faiss, PostgreSQL with vector extensions (pgvector).
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
MLOps Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar.
Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
CI/CD Tools: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar.
Version Control: Git
Data Visualization & Reporting: Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn.
Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases.

jobs.description:
About the Role: Where Your Engineering Actually Ships

The AI-Augmented Full-Stack Engineer is a senior individual contributor
position within Citi's Banking Technology organization. This team builds and
maintains the applications and platforms that put real capital to work for clients across one of the world's largest financial institutions.

This is a hands-on engineering
role. You will design, develop, and ship full-stack solutions
while helping shape how the team builds software - embedding AI into the engineering craft as a natural and practical part of daily work, not as an afterthought.

If you are a senior engineer who writes excellent code, thinks clearly about systems, and wants to work on problems that matter - this role was written for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Full-Stack Design and Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver full-stack applications using Java and Spring Boot on the backend and Angular on the frontend, with meaningful input into technical direction and architectural decisions.
AI-Augmented Engineering Practice: Embed AI development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Codex into your daily engineering workflow as the default way of working - and actively drive that same adoption across the team. Establish shared standards for prompt engineering, code review, and quality guardrails so that AI-augmented development becomes the team's natural practice, not the exception.
Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence: Set the technical bar for the team through thoughtful code reviews, clear architectural guidance, and hands-on problem solving. Mentor mid-level engineers not through instruction alone, but by demonstrating what excellent engineering looks like in practice every day.
Data Management and Architecture: Apply sound data design principles across both relational and NoSQL databases - Oracle and MongoDB - with a focus on data integrity, schema design, and query performance. Champion data standards that keep systems maintainable and trustworthy at scale.
Cloud-Native Engineering Mindset: Bring a strong conceptual understanding of modern cloud-native principles - infrastructure as code, containerization with Docker and OpenShift, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and engineering practices that optimize for delivery throughput and system stability. You do not need to own the pipes, but you need to think about them.
Engineering Judgement and Accountability: Make decisions with the full picture in mind - technical quality, business impact, security, and regulatory context. Bring the kind of professional judgement that earns trust with stakeholders and keeps the team building with confidence.

What You Bring

Experience And Qualifications

6+ of software engineering experience, with meaningful time in a senior, lead, or principal capacity on complex, enterprise-grade systems
Experience delivering software in a financial service, fintech, or similarly regulated, high-complexity environment
Proven ability to provide technical leadership and mentor engineers in a senior individual contributor capacity
Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to engineering and business audiences alike
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Technical Skills

Backend: Strong working knowledge of Java and the Spring Framework ecosystem
Frontend: Hands-on experience with Angular. Familiarity with React or other modern frameworks is a plus
Databases: Working knowledge of both relational and NoSQL databases, including Oracle and MongoDB
AI Fluency: Practical, daily use of AI coding tools with a solid conceptual understanding of how they work - including prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tokenization, and grounding techniques. You know enough about what is happening under the hood to use these tools with intention, not just habit
Cloud Awareness: Familiarity with cloud-native concepts - containerization, infrastructure as code, CI/CD practices, and delivery metrics such as DORA. Comfortable reasoning about system design in a cloud-native context

Preferred

Experience with Angular at production scale; React or Vue as additional frontend exposure
Exposure to agentic AI patterns, MCP, A2A workflows, or agent development frameworks such as Google ADK
Familiarity with 12-Factor App principles and microservices architecture
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

What Success Looks Like

You have personally delivered features that are in production, trusted by the business, and cited as examples of how good engineering is done here.
Stakeholders - technical and non-technical - come to you with hard problems because they trust your judgement and your ability to translate complexity into a clear, actionable direction.
The engineers around you are measurably better for working alongside you. Not because you ran workshops, but because your code, your reviews, and your approach set a standard worth following.
You have shaped how AI is used on this team - not by mandating tools, but by demonstrating what thoughtful, effective AI-augmented engineering actually looks like in practice.
Problems that previously stalled the team get solved. You are the person who unblocks things - through technical depth, clear thinking, and the confidence to make a call.

Why Join Us?

Solve Problems That Are Hard to Find Elsewhere: The systems here run at a scale and complexity that few engineering environments can match.
Own the AI Practice, Not Just Use It: You will define how this team adopts, evaluates, and improves its use of AI - from day one.
Senior IC With Real Autonomy: High visibility, high trust, and the freedom to do serious work without a people management overhead.
An Institution That Invests in Its Engineers: Access to modern infrastructure, strong internal tooling, and a team that takes the craft seriously.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master’s degree preferred

new_jobs.description:
Our Company Background & Culture

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.

UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.

Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.

As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Director, Data & Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.

This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.

This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (two days per week in-office).

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Specific Accountabilities

The Senior Director, Data & Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:

Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
Guide the use of cloud-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self-asses the capabilities for progress
Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non-technical audiences.
Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector

Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
Understanding of relational and non-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
Experience designing and evolving cloud-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.

ATTRIBUTES

Excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to design and improve repeatable data practices
Ability to drive outcomes through collaboration across teams and contributors
Ability to engage and align business users, data owners and technology partners.
Ability to effectively identify emerging technologies, trends, standards, and products that have a strong potential to better enable UPP business units
Ability to enable consistent, governed data use at scale.

LIFE AT UPP

Do work that matters.
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

Stronger together.
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.

The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.

This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.

At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work.
The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.

About Level

We're an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We've been named one of Pittsburgh's Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

What You'll Own:

Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You'll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You'll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans
Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You'll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You'll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent
Strategy Brief Development: You'll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins
Audience, Market & Category Insights: You'll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You'll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams
Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You'll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients' media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You'll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework
Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You'll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You'll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting
Strategic Performance Storytelling: You'll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations
Client Strategic Partnership: You'll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You'll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact
Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You'll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You'll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent
Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You'll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges
Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You'll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You'll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline
Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You'll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You'll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Skills & Qualifications:

Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines
Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies
Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence
Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative
Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities
Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders
Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges

Education & Experience:

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment
Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels
Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies
Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients
Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field
Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required
Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work
You are expected to:
Experiment continuously with AI tools (eg, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (eg, draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets)
Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together
Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process
Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine

AI is not a shortcut—it's a skillset. You're expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart
Better Every Day We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar
Relentless for Results Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward
Driven by Truth We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.
